data.body: Additional flaky test sighting: test_state_merge_sha_recorded in test-merge-to-main.sh fails on CI with 'python parse error' across PRs #203, #205, #206, #207, #209 (run 26008599446). Same root cause as the original test_state_write_phase_* failures — Python parse error on a state file likely being read mid-write. Local execution passes. Expanding scope of this bug to cover ALL test_state_* parse_error patterns in test-merge-to-main.sh.
